core_obligations: Retain full del Pezzo, non-singular half-anticanonical surface and rank-one kernel hypotheses.
Retain pencil geometry, rank-one vanishing cycle monodromy and degree (D.S)^2 computation.
Retain supporting constant Picard divisor and restriction equation explicitly used in the specialization argument.
Retain complete irreducibility, immersion, balanced normal bundle and regularity/enumerativity arguments of Section 3.
Retain full final monodromy-orbit summation and one-half factor.
proof_roadmap: Construct the pencil and identify rank-one monodromy.
Compute Picard quotient degree and retain restriction identity.
Specialize incidence points to the elliptic base and prove enumerativity via immersion/balanced normal bundles.
Sum over monodromy orbits and recover the full formula.
difficulty_reason: Nonroutine core connects rank-one Picard–Lefschetz monodromy and the degree of a pencil-to-elliptic-Picard-quotient map with specialized incidence configurations. The complete current proof controls irreducibility, immersion and balanced normal bundles to preserve enumerativity, then handles monodromy orbits and the factor 1/2. These constructions and deformation/enumeration steps, rather than only the terminal formula, remain in the counted unit.
difficulty_assessment_limits: H2 supported by retained geometric construction and regularity bridge. No H3 claim or independent correctness certification.
